spec.title: The trap that cost a shilling

segments.say: White grabbed one free pawn, and seven moves later this happened. Here's how.
segments.caption: One greedy move...

segments.say: Black plays knight d4 and leaves the e5 pawn hanging. It's bait.
segments.caption: Free pawn?

segments.say: White takes it. Black's queen jumps to g5, attacking g2.
segments.caption: Queen g5!

segments.say: White takes f7, forking queen and rook. Feels winning. Queen takes g2.
segments.caption: Greedy knight

segments.say: Rook f1. Queen takes e4, check. Bishop blocks.
segments.caption: Check!

segments.say: It's called the Blackburne Shilling trap. Tag a friend who grabs free pawns.
segments.caption: Tag a pawn grabber
